type.families: Geometric or humanist sans at small sizes (Inter, General Sans). Monospace for identifiers, ports and payload snippets.
type.hierarchy: Node title 13/18 medium · node body 12/16 regular · port label 10/13 mono · canvas heading 20/26 medium. Everything is small — the canvas is the subject, not the type.
type.usage: Sentence case. Monospace for any machine-facing string. Truncate aggressively inside nodes; the node is a summary, not a document.

tokens.texture: Matte and flat — this is the dark style with no glow. Cards are solid `--surface` with a 1px `--line` border and no shadow beyond a tight `0 2px 8px rgb(0 0 0 / .5)`. The ground is a dotted canvas: `radial-gradient(var(--dot) 1px, transparent 1px)` at a 24px grid. Connections are 2px bezier curves in `--muted` that turn `--accent` when active, ending in solid triangular arrowheads or small port dots.
tokens.layout: An infinite canvas, not a page. Nodes are 240-320px wide cards placed freely and wired together; a floating toolbar pill and a minimap dock over the canvas. 4px scale inside nodes, 12px node padding, 10px radius. Presentation trick: photograph the canvas at a slight tilt with everything but one node racked out of focus, so a single node reads as the subject.

best_for: any product whose object is a graph

recipe.medium: macro photograph of a dark screen at a slight tilt, shallow depth of field
constraints: near-black #0B0B0B ground with a faint regular dot grid
matte graphite panels, absolutely no glow or bloom
one green #3FBF52 as the only saturated colour, on connector lines only
shallow depth of field — one element sharp, the rest falling off
slight perspective tilt, cool neutral colour temperature
recipe.negative_space: The out-of-focus region should occupy the outer half of the frame.

type.families: Geometric sans for chrome; a high-contrast display serif or italic didone permitted for one hero line. Monospace acceptable for timecodes and metadata.
type.hierarchy: Hero 52/58 regular, optionally breaking mid-line into italic serif · control label 12/16 medium · metadata 11/14 mono · body 15/23 regular at 66% white.
type.usage: The signature move is a grotesque headline that breaks into italic display serif for one clause. Keep all chrome type small and quiet so the image carries the frame.

tokens.texture: Glass over film. Panels use `background: rgba(24,24,24,.55); backdrop-filter: blur(28px) saturate(120%);` with a 1px `rgba(255,255,255,.14)` inner stroke. Behind them, full-bleed photography or a defocused macro fills the entire viewport. A 4-6% grain overlay unifies the composite. Never place a solid opaque panel over the image — everything floats translucent.
tokens.layout: The image is the layout. Chrome reduces to floating pills and small glass cards docked to edges and corners, leaving the centre of the frame to the photograph. 8px scale, 999px radius on controls, 18-24px on glass cards, 16px padding. Content sits in the lower third or along one edge, never centred over the subject.

best_for: creative tools with a visual output

recipe.medium: cinematic photograph, shallow depth of field, film grain
constraints: full-bleed photographic image, dark overall exposure
single strong light source with deep shadows retaining detail
desaturated except one hot accent note near #D9E82A
visible fine film grain
wide cinematic framing with the subject off-centre
negative: text or UI in the image
recipe.negative_space: The lower third must fall dark and uncluttered for glass panels and type.

type.families: Geometric sans, light to regular (Aeonik, General Sans, Outfit). Low weight contrast.
type.hierarchy: Title 22/28 regular · figure 34/38 light · body 14/21 regular · label 11/14 regular in `--muted`. Thin, wide-set type suits the soft ground.
type.usage: Keep weights light — bold type fights the translucency. Sentence case. Labels sit above values, not beside them.

tokens.texture: Every surface is carved out of the gradient rather than drawn on top of it: `background: rgba(255,255,255,.55); backdrop-filter: blur(24px);` with a 1px inner highlight `rgba(255,255,255,.6)` and no outer border. One blurred colour metaball (a 320px circle of `--accent` at 30% opacity, `filter: blur(80px)`) drifts behind the content to give the field variation. Shadows are wide and faint.
tokens.layout: Soft and generous. 8px scale, 24px padding, 20-24px radius on cards, 999px on every control. Because nothing has a border, rely on 20px+ gaps for separation. Charts render as translucent gradient-filled bars or dot matrices, never as hard strokes.

recipe.medium: soft 3D render or gradient abstraction with frosted glass elements
constraints: pale periwinkle-to-ice gradient ground
translucent frosted panels with visible blur of what sits behind them
one muted violet #5D51C8 and one seafoam #69C6AE as the only hues
soft omnidirectional lighting, no hard shadows
rounded organic forms, generous corner radii
recipe.negative_space: The upper half stays a clean uninterrupted gradient.

type.families: Neo-grotesque or geometric sans (Inter Display, General Sans, Aeonik). The headline is the whole design.
type.hierarchy: Hero 68/68 semibold at -0.035em · section 36/42 semibold at -0.025em · body 16/26 regular in `--muted` · label 12/16 medium. Enormous tightly-tracked headlines against small grey body is the entire hierarchy.
type.usage: Set headlines as large and as tight as legibility allows. Body copy stays grey and small. Sentence case. Never letterspace the hero.

tokens.texture: Atmosphere with no material. Behind crisp white cards sit one or two very large soft radial blooms (`radial-gradient(50% 40% at 20% 0%, var(--bloom-a), transparent 70%)`) — pure colour haze, no grain, no glass, no bevel. Cards themselves are flat white with a hairline border and a soft wide shadow (`0 8px 32px -12px rgb(12 12 12 / .12)`). The contrast between hazy ground and razor-sharp card is the effect.
tokens.layout: Marketing rhythm: full-width sections, centred hero, generous vertical spacing (96-140px between sections). 8px scale, 24px card padding, 16px radius, 999px on the primary pill CTA. Product screenshots bleed in from the bottom edge of the hero rather than sitting in a frame.

avoid_for: products needing a dark mode as primary

recipe.medium: soft gradient abstraction or clean product render on a light ground
constraints: near-white #F2F2F3 ground
one or two very large soft colour blooms in cool blue and warm peach, heavily feathered
any product surface rendered crisp and sharp against the soft ground
even soft lighting, no visible light source
no texture, grain or noise anywhere
recipe.negative_space: Keep the centre-top clear for a large headline — at least 35% of the frame.

type.families: Neo-grotesque or rounded humanist (Inter, Plus Jakarta Sans, Nunito Sans). Slight roundness in the letterforms helps.
type.hierarchy: Page title 26/32 semibold · card title 16/22 semibold · figure 30/36 semibold · body 14/21 regular · chip 11/15 medium. Comfortable, never cramped.
type.usage: Sentence case throughout. Pastel chips carry dark ink of their own hue family, never white. Numbers get room to breathe — this style never crams a table.

tokens.texture: Depth comes from shadow, not borders. Cards are white with a 20-24px radius and `0 2px 8px rgb(19 28 51 / .06)`, optionally a hairline. The whole app often sits in a rounded shell (28px radius) inset in a tinted `--bg` field with 24-40px of margin. Charts are friendly: lollipop bars with circular caps, capsule-tracked bars, soft gradient fills.
tokens.layout: Roomy. 8px scale, 24px card padding, 20px gaps, 16-24px radius everywhere, 999px on pills and avatars. Nothing touches anything. Where Hairline Ledger fits 24 rows, this fits 8 — that is the trade and the point.

avoid_for: enterprise admin with hundreds of rows
brands needing a severe or technical tone

recipe.medium: soft 3D render or rounded flat illustration
constraints: pale lavender-grey ground #E7E8F0
rounded matte forms with large corner radii and no sharp edges
pastel accent palette — mint, lilac, peach — plus one indigo #4A46D8
soft diffused lighting with gentle contact shadows
friendly geometric shapes, generous spacing between elements
recipe.negative_space: Keep at least a third of the frame as empty tinted ground.

type.families: A high-contrast display serif for headlines (Playfair Display, Prata, Bodoni Moda, Instrument Serif) paired with a plain neo-grotesque for everything else. The pairing is the style — never set a headline in the sans.
type.hierarchy: Hero serif 72/74 regular · section serif 44/50 regular · sans body 16/26 regular · sans label 12/16 medium ALL-CAPS 0.08em. The serif appears only at display sizes; below 24px it is always the sans.
type.usage: Centre the hero. Let the serif's thick-thin contrast do the decorating — no italic, no underline, no colour on the headline. Body copy is quiet grey sans.

tokens.texture: Print-flat. No gradients on surfaces, no glass, no glow. The one material moment is a soft photograph (cloud, sky, landscape) that dissolves into the page background behind the hero type via a mask or a white gradient. The signature component is a black pill button with a circular tangerine arrow chip welded onto its trailing end.
tokens.layout: Editorial symmetry. Centred hero with a tight measure (max 20 characters per headline line), generous 120px+ section rhythm, 8px scale. Cards are black or white rectangles with 16-20px radius. A flat tangerine field ruled with a faint architectural grid works as a section break.

recipe.medium: soft natural photograph, high-key, dissolving into white
constraints: paper-white ground the image fades into with no hard edge
soft natural light — clouds, sky, or diffused landscape
muted natural palette with one tangerine #E85A00 note
high-key exposure, gentle contrast
generous symmetrical composition
recipe.negative_space: The upper half fades to near-white so a serif headline can sit over it.

type.families: Three voices, deliberately. A serif for headlines (Instrument Serif, Fraunces, Source Serif), a neo-grotesque for UI and body, and a monospace (JetBrains Mono, IBM Plex Mono) for every figure, date and code.
type.hierarchy: Headline serif 48/54 regular, ending in a full stop · deck 18/28 sans regular · body 15/24 sans · figures mono 14/20 · issue labels 10/12 mono ALL-CAPS 0.14em.
type.usage: Headlines end with a period — magazine grammar. Monospace figures appear *inline in running prose*, not just in tables. Letterspaced ALL-CAPS mono for section and issue labels.

tokens.texture: A translucent white page sheet (`rgba(255,255,255,.86)`, optional `backdrop-filter: blur(8px)`) floats over a full-bleed defocused landscape photograph. Surfaces are otherwise print-flat. Corners are softly rounded (16-20px) on the sheet, square on internal rules. A faint grain is acceptable over the photograph only.
tokens.layout: A page, not a screen. One centred column (max 720px) of content sitting on the sheet, with the photograph bleeding to all four edges behind it. 8px scale, 32-40px sheet padding, hairline rules between sections instead of cards. Data, when present, is set as a magazine table — ruled, mono, right-aligned.

best_for: brands with real photography to spend

recipe.medium: landscape photograph, natural light, slightly defocused
constraints: full-bleed natural landscape — hills, field, forest, sky
soft overcast or golden-hour light, no harsh sun
muted natural greens and earth tones, low saturation
slight defocus so the image reads as a backdrop, not a subject
horizon placed low or high, never centred
recipe.negative_space: The centre must be quiet and low-contrast so a white sheet of type can sit on it.

type.families: A condensed or expressive display face for headlines (Anton, Archivo Expanded, Bricolage Grotesque, PP Right Grotesk) with a plain geometric sans for body. The display face should be strange enough to be memorable.
type.hierarchy: Poster headline 96/88 display, justified to the full column width · section 32/36 display · body 16/25 sans · label 12/15 sans medium ALL-CAPS 0.06em.
type.usage: Set the headline enormous and justify it edge to edge — the type is a graphic element, not a label. Ink is a chosen brand colour (deep aubergine, chocolate, forest), never plain black.

tokens.texture: Print, not screen. Flat colour bands with hard edges, zero shadows, zero gradients. Optional paper grain at 4%. Shapes are cut with jagged, zigzag or arc section dividers rather than straight rules. Cut-out photography and mascot illustration overlap and interrupt the type.
tokens.layout: Edge-to-edge horizontal bands, each a different flat colour, stacked down the page. No card floats above another — everything is inline in its band. 8px scale, 0-8px radius (sharp is the default), 64-96px band padding. Elements deliberately break their band's boundary to create energy.

avoid_for: products needing a neutral canvas for user content

recipe.medium: flat vector illustration or silkscreen-style poster art
constraints: flat spot colours with hard edges and no gradients
limited palette — cream #FBFBEF, mustard #F5CE3E, forest #0F6B4C, coral #D96A5E
cut-out photographic elements at mismatched scales, hard-masked
subtle paper grain overlay
bold overlapping geometric shapes
recipe.negative_space: One flat band of solid colour must stay empty for the headline.

type.families: Neo-grotesque or geometric sans, weight-alternating within a single headline (one clause light, the next semibold).
type.hierarchy: Headline 44/48 with mixed weights · body 15/23 regular · label 11/14 medium ALL-CAPS 0.1em · single display numeral up to 120px when the object is a metric.
type.usage: Alternate weight inside one headline rather than using colour or size for emphasis. Keep all UI type small — the render should dominate.

tokens.texture: The object is the page. A single matte 3D render — a sphere in liquid, an isometric building, a device — fills most of the frame, lit softly in a grey studio. UI reduces to hairline pill buttons and small floating micro-panels docked to the render, often with thin leader lines connecting a label to a point on the object. Surfaces are matte; no gloss, no neon.
tokens.layout: Composition over structure. The render occupies 60-75% of the viewport; content is docked to one edge or floats over a quiet area of the image. 8px scale, 999px radius on pills, 12px on micro-panels, 16px padding. Hairline leader lines (1px, `--line`) tie annotations to the object.

recipe.medium: matte 3D product render, grey seamless studio
constraints: flat mid-grey #D6D6D6 seamless background with soft falloff
one object centred, matte finish, no gloss or chrome
soft large key light from above-left, gentle contact shadow
near-monochrome with at most one small colour note
orthographic or mild isometric projection
recipe.negative_space: At least 30% flat grey ground on one side for docked UI and type.
